title: Ringdown spectroscopy of binary black hole mergers and tests of the no-hair theorem
abstract: We analyse quasinormal mode overtones in the ringdown of gravitational-wave signals from binary black hole mergers to test the Kerr hypothesis.

title: Eccentric waveform models for compact binary coalescences
abstract: We construct effective-one-body waveforms for eccentric binary black holes calibrated to numerical relativity simulations, for LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA parameter estimation.

title: Bayesian inference of neutron star equation of state from gravitational waves
abstract: Tidal deformability measured in binary neutron star inspirals constrains the dense matter equation of state.

title: Stochastic gravitational-wave background from cosmic strings
abstract: We compute the stochastic background spectrum from cosmic string loops and forecast sensitivity for pulsar timing arrays and LISA.

title: Extreme mass ratio inspirals and self-force
abstract: Gravitational self-force calculations for extreme mass-ratio inspirals into Kerr black holes, relevant for LISA.
